head: ZIV Live: wedding photo sharing with a QR code, no app needed
dek: ZIV Live collects the photos and videos guests take at a wedding or party into one private gallery: they scan a QR code and upload, with no app or account. You pay once per event, from $5.
details: Moment costs $5 and stays live for three days with videos up to 1 GB; Memory costs $20 for three weeks, 2 GB videos and a big-screen mode; Milestone costs $60 for three months and 4 GB videos. The clock starts at the first upload, every original stays in full resolution, and uploads are screened automatically. Galleries are invite-only and deleted when the time runs out. It's made by ZIV Live, Inc.
where: Web, works on any phone; one payment per event
means: If you're planning a wedding or party, guests can share their pictures in one place without installing anything.
todo: Pick the plan by how long you need the gallery, and download the originals before it's deleted.
